# Chinese Mountains
An independent guide to every famous peak in China. Interactive maps, detailed guides, comparison tools, and a 3-step quiz to help you find your perfect mountain.

## Key Pages
- Home (Decision Engine): https://www.chinese-mountains.com/
- Explore All Mountains: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/explore
- Best Mountains Ranking: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/best
- Compare Mountains Tool: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/compare
- Travel Guides: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/guides
- Photo Gallery: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/gallery
- Collections (Five Great Mountains, Buddhist & Daoist peaks): https://www.chinese-mountains.com/collections
- About: https://www.chinese-mountains.com/about
